result.topic_en: Finding all solutions of the congruence 1 + x^2 + y^2 ≡ 0 (mod p), relating them to (x+iy)^{p+1} ≡ -1 for p ≡ 3 mod 4, generating all solutions from one by a rational parametrization, and treating the case p ≡ 1 mod 4 with p = a^2 + b^2.

methods.what: Solutions of 1+x^2+y^2≡0 mod p, p≡3 mod 4, coincide with solutions of 1+(x+iy)^{p+1}≡0 (norm map in F_{p^2})
Rational parametrization of the unit circle x^2+y^2=1
Generating all solutions from one by multiplying by norm-one elements (u+i)/(u-i), u running over 0..p-1
For p≡1 mod 4, p=a^2+b^2, all solutions x+iy given by (b/a)(u+i)/(u-i), excluding u=a/b and u=b/a
